jobs.title: Regional Product Manager
jobs.description:
This strategic role will drive product management excellence for our growing aftermarket portfolio. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial and technical expertise to optimize our product offering while collaborating across a global organization.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead product lifecycle management from strategy to execution

- Develop business cases for portfolio expansion and optimization

- Serve as the primary product expert supporting sales and customer engagements

- Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, buyer, marketing and Sales

- Drive pricing strategy alignment with regional and global objectives

- Analyze market trends and competitive landscape

- Facilitate knowledge transfer between global and regional teams

Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or related field

- 5+ years experience in automotive product management

- Strong commercial acumen with P&L understanding

- Excellent communication skills in English and Mandarin

- Proven ability to work in matrix organizations

Preferred Attributes
- Experience in automotive aftermarket

- Technical understanding of vehicle systems

- Exposure to electronics/electric components is a plus
